source: Domiciano de Souza et al. (2021), A&A 654, A19, Table 3, power-law limb darkening with bandwidth smearing, the paper's reference model, fitted to the VLTI/PIONIER data (https://doi.org/10.1051/0004-6361/202140478)
band: VLTI/PIONIER H band, 1.5-1.8 um; not a visible band
note: I(mu)/I(1) = mu^alpha, as the paper's Table 2 defines its power law. Fitted with the angular diameter 7.184 mas to 1639 squared visibilities and 1059 closure phases. The only measured limb of Canopus; the visible limb is not measured.
